curatedMovie.curiosityHook: After a corrupt club owner and the local sheriff con them, how far will these humiliated teens go to pull off their payback?
curatedMovie.description: In 1954 Florida, a crew of high school classmates ventures out to an Everglades strip club. After the crooked owner and his sheriff brother take their cash and humiliate them, the teens scheme to get even.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light, rowdy, and easygoing comedy with a steady comic rhythm and low emotional stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Bob Clark delivers a raucous, briskly paced 1950s sex comedy fueled by high-spirited mischief, small-town corruption, and a shared drive for payback.
